<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈12 % M+1) suggests ~11–12 carbons. A formula that matches this mass within typical MS tolerance is C₁₂H₁₆O₂ (exact neutral mass 192.1150 Da, [M+H]⁺ 193.1223 Da, ~60 ppm from the observed value, the best fit among reasonable C/H/O candidates). Therefore the molecular formula is C12H16O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
